move: two blurred diagonal light bands sweep purple ground, one period per loop
how: A 2600px square rotated -35 degrees holds two repeating-linear-gradient bands (warm pink-orange-yellow, cooler blue-violet) with screen blend and blur 6 to 10px over a dark purple base. The warm band translates x -1300 to 0 and the cool band -650 to 650, each exactly one gradient period, over D with power1.inOut so the sweep pushes and settles yet stays seamless; a centred wordmark breathes scale 0.98 to 1.02 on sine yoyo, and a radial darkening keeps edges deep.
adapt: Change the gradient stop colours, the band angle and the wordmark; keep the translate distance equal to the repeating period (1300px) so the loop closes.
port: mount(el, shot) appends .base, .band with .i/.j, .soft, .title, .sub; animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with duration D. Scope '.band .i', '.band .j', '.title' to el.
caveats: 2600px rotated layers with blur and screen blend are expensive to composite
power1.inOut on a seamless period makes the sweep visibly slow down at the loop point
